title: Asean OKs early rollout of updated trade pact amid Middle East crisis

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Member states of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) have agreed to provisionally implement an updated regional trade agreement ahead of its formal entry into force next year, a move aimed at deepening trade within the region amid disruptions caused by the continuing Middle East crisis. The agreement allows member states to apply the Second Protocol to Amend the Asean Trade in Goods Agreement (Atiga) on a “voluntary and reciprocal” basis among countries that are ready to do so. The declaration was adopted in Pasay City by 10 Asean member states, excluding Timor-Leste, on Saturday during the 58th […]...
